## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

The per-model defaults correct generated vector schemas for models whose outputs differ from 768 dimensions while preserving the existing default. The lookup is a small, deterministic solution that avoids an API call during schema construction.

Please mark this PR with the `breaking-change` label: `lancedb.embeddings.JinaEmbeddings.ndims()` now raises `ValueError` for unlisted model names, so callers using those names must handle the new error.

**Documentation:** In the [Jina guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/f1c9aef241fea8633efdc2cc3bff9045922f0f1c/docs/web/integrations/embedding/jina.mdx) and the class docstring, describe the model names recognized by `ndims()` and its error for other names; the guide currently directs readers to Jina's broader model catalog.
